const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided RoboCasa OpenDrawer episode controller and action record.
+
+Run a phase with --name and --steps/--channel arguments. The resulting
+observations and exact actions are kept in /app/runs for inspection.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+LAYOUT = ["arm_dx", "arm_dy", "arm_dz", "arm_drx", "arm_dry", "arm_drz",
+          "grip", "base_x", "base_y", "base_yaw", "torso", "hybrid_mode"]
+
+
+def send(name, steps, commands, cameras=None):
+    robot = Robot()
+    action = np.zeros((steps, 12), dtype=np.float64)
+    action[:, 6] = -1.0
+    action[:, 11] = -1.0
+    for key, value in commands.items():
+        action[:, LAYOUT.index(key)] = value
+    cameras = cameras or ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_right",
+                          "robot0_eye_in_hand"]
+    result = robot.submit("ee_delta", action, cameras=cameras,
+                          include_depth=True, video="none", note=name)
+    folder = Path("/app/runs") / name
+    result.save(str(folder))
+    (folder / "actions.npy").write_bytes(action.tobytes())
+    (folder / "command.json").write_text(json.dumps({"steps": steps, "commands": commands}, indent=2))
+    p = dict(zip(result.meta["proprio"]["layout"], result.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    print(json.dumps({"name": name, "steps": result.meta["control_steps"],
+                      "time_left_s": result.meta["time_left_s"],
+                      "eef": [p[k] for k in ("eef_right_x", "eef_right_y", "eef_right_z")],
+                      "base": [p[k] for k in ("mobilebase0_joint_mobile_forward_pos",
+                                              "mobilebase0_joint_mobile_side_pos",
+                                              "mobilebase0_joint_mobile_yaw_pos")],
+                      "finger": [p[k] for k in ("gripper0_right_finger_joint1_pos",
+                                                "gripper0_right_finger_joint2_pos")]}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--steps", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--channel", action="append", default=[], help="name=value")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    commands = {key: float(value) for key, value in (x.split("=", 1) for x in args.channel)}
+    send(args.name, args.steps, commands)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
